_comment: The ONE place that says which upstream PoB pob-rust targets (R-UP). Read by tools/upstream.ts (probes), tools/sync-data.ps1 (data converter: tools/data-convert) and pob-golden (Rust tests). Env vars POB_ROOT / POB_GOLDENS_DIR override. Nothing here points outside pob-rust and upstream PoB (R-INDEPENDENT-UPDATE). Paths: absolute, or relative to the repo root.
